response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience in agentic AI systems at scale, fintech infrastructure, or regulated AI deployment, and has no evidence of executive leadership, team scaling beyond individual contributor roles, or architecture of real-time credit/risk systems — all core requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering skills with diverse language proficiency
Active open-source contributions and technical communication via workshops
Experience with event-driven systems and microservices in high-throughput contexts
concerns: No evidence of building or operating production multi-agent AI systems
Lacks fintech domain experience (credit, working capital, compliance)
No track record leading engineering teams beyond 10 people or executive decision-making

key_factors.factor: Lack of executive leadership and team scaling
